bio.text: John Joyce, M.D., has represented Pennsylvania's 13th Congressional District in the U.S. House since January 2019 and chairs the Energy and Commerce Oversight and Investigations Subcommittee.
He earned his undergraduate degree at Penn State and his medical degree at Temple University, trained at Johns Hopkins Hospital, and is board-certified in internal medicine and dermatology.
He served in the U.S. Navy at Portsmouth Naval Hospital during Desert Storm and, with his wife, co-founded Altoona Dermatology Associates in 1991.
